edit.statement: If one party lends money to a second and the second lends money to a third, the first party also lends money to the third.
edit.subject: lendsTo
edit.original: Lending does not chain: lending money to a borrower does not mean lending to whoever that borrower lends to.
edit.scope: A loan is made from lender to borrower; reciprocal and third-party loans are not implied.
